scripts.check: npm run check:workspace && npm run check:widi && npm run check:python
scripts.check:workspace: npm --prefix packages/widi exec -- biome check package.json scripts/run-widi.mjs .widi-scholar/settings.json .widi-scholar/agent/models.json .widi-scholar/themes/prism.json
scripts.check:python: uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check .
scripts.format: npm run format:workspace && npm --prefix packages/widi run format && uv run ruff check --fix . && uv run ruff format .
scripts.format:workspace: npm --prefix packages/widi exec -- biome check --write package.json scripts/run-widi.mjs .widi-scholar/settings.json .widi-scholar/agent/models.json .widi-scholar/themes/prism.json
